headline: The sea window you were promised is open right now, a notch rougher than advertised, and it shuts at 11:00.
body:
Thursday arrived and the window held - but it slipped. A fresh fetch this morning puts **06:00-11:00** at a **28 km/h** gust, not the **25** the last two briefs promised, which moves open water from 'good' to 'care'. Swimmable, choppier than advertised. Midday goes to **41** and shuts it.

So go now: **1,200-1,500 m** at **2:20-2:35/100 m**, no sprint off the start. Steady because the gate is still fired on the last numbers I hold - **hrv 65 then 63 against a 69.1 mean**, 1-2 October, nothing since to clear it. Sighting is the whole point: most of your 2 km loss is swimming further than 2 km, not slower.

Saturday's second bite has gone - **36 km/h**, open water poor. Next after this morning is **Sunday early, 26 km/h**.

The laptop is still asleep: **eleven** push windows empty, 3-7 October invisible. Did the pool happen yesterday? And how is the ankle - it is **18 days** since you last ran.
